profile.name: Potluru Penchala Eswar
profile.tagline: Building robust systems from silicon to software
profile.bio: Fresh Electronics & Communication Engineering graduate with a strong foundation in C/C++ and system-level programming. I am currently undergoing an Advanced Embedded Systems Course at Emertxe Information Technologies, enhancing my skills in system programming, Linux, and network programming. Through hands-on academic projects, I've gained real experience in hardware-software co-development, low-level communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C), and real-time system diagnostics. I am passionate about deconstructing complex problems into efficient, elegant code and building reliable embedded systems.

projects.title: Car Black Box
projects.subtitle: Embedded Systems Project
projects.description: Developed a Car Black Box system to monitor and log critical vehicle data in real time using the I²C communication protocol. Captured parameters via sensors, synchronized with precise timestamp information provided by a Real-Time Clock (RTC), and stored in an external EEPROM for non-volatile secure data retention.

projects.title: Autonomous Navigation & Scanning System
projects.subtitle: Academic Project
projects.description: Developed an autonomous robot capable of obstacle detection and automatic path correction using ESP32-CAM and Robot Operating System. Integrated GPS-based tracking and controlled DC motors using the L298N Motor Driver Module for smooth movement.

projects.title: Lexical Analyzer
projects.subtitle: Compiler Design Project
projects.description: Built a program that converts a stream of characters into lexical tokens such as keywords, identifiers, and symbols. Implemented file handling techniques in C to read and process source code files line by line, and utilized string comparison and pattern matching for classification.

projects.title: MP3 Tag Reader
projects.subtitle: Advanced C Project
projects.description: Developed a software application to read and display MP3 (ID3) tag information from MP3 files. Strengthened skills in binary file parsing, hexadecimal data interpretation, and correct byte order conversion (big-endian to little-endian) to handle multi-byte fields.

projects.title: Image Steganography using LSB
projects.subtitle: Advanced C Project
projects.description: Created a command-line tool to hide secret information within a BMP image file without altering its visible properties. Manipulated the least significant bits (LSB) of the image data, handled encoding and decoding of message lengths, and resolved issues with shifting and masking bits.

projects.title: Arbitrary Precision Calculator
projects.subtitle: Advanced C Project
projects.description: Developed an Arbitrary Precision Calculator to perform basic mathematical operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) on very large numbers, ensuring exact results regardless of data size.

projects.title: Inverted Search Engine
projects.subtitle: Advanced C Project
projects.description: Built an inverted index to map words to their occurrences across multiple documents. Parsed files to extract words and stored locations using custom indexing structures (hashing, linked lists) for efficient retrieval.

projects.title: Address Book
projects.subtitle: Advanced C Project
projects.description: Developed a console-based contact management application with standard I/O for adding, updating, searching, and deleting contacts. Managed file operations and dynamic memory effectively to prevent segmentation faults.

education.institution: Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology

competencies.title: Systems Integration & Testing
competencies.description: Setting up hardware rigs, validating propulsion controls, wiring signal buses, and end-to-end system verification.

competencies.title: Debugging & Diagnostics
competencies.description: Methodical debugging approaches, memory profiling, and root-cause analysis for hardware-software issues in C.

competencies.title: System Programming
competencies.description: Linux kernel system calls, TCP/UDP network programming, and IPC mechanisms (Pipe, FIFO, Shared Memory).

competencies.title: Collaboration & Adaptability
competencies.description: Effective communicator who values teamwork, adaptable to new technologies and quick at grasping complex technical concepts.
